prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE production sprite atlas for a children's woodland game. Transparent RGBA. Strict grid of FOUR columns and THREE rows, each equal square cell, target aspect4:3, ideally2048x1536. Every drawing isolated in its cell with 10% transparent padding. No grid, labels, words or background. Fine detailed watercolor/gouache, sage green, warm honey oak, peach/cream flowers; match input1 Duri character and input2 woodland painting palette. No Momo, no additional characters.
ROW1, columns1-4: (1) one pink daisy with full stem and two green leaves; (2) same flower design in warm yellow; (3) same flower design in lavender purple; (4) closed green flower bud with the SAME stem and two leaves, petal tips just visible. Same stem base and silhouette proportions for all four.
ROW2, columns1-4: (1) a sage green wooden forest toy BUS in strict SIDE VIEW, THREE equal square empty cream windows across its side, short hood/front at right, two visible wooden wheels, no passengers; (2) a single wide triangular moss-covered wooden cottage ROOF piece, frontal view, no walls; (3) a single honey wood cottage WALL panel with rounded cream window and small flower box, frontal; (4) matching WALL panel with arched wooden door, frontal. These are separate toy building parts, no complete extra houses.
ROW3 contains DURI in FOUR grounded full-body exercise poses, same height/foot baseline/face/proportions and fur as reference: (1) friendly bear with both arms stretched horizontally out to sides; (2) bear with both arms gently raised upward above shoulders; (3) bear marching gently in place, one knee lifted a little and opposite paw forward, no jumping; (4) bear resting calmly with both paws together on belly and eyes softly closed. Preserve brown round ears, cream muzzle/belly and friendly expression. Short toddler-like proportions, no clothing, no extra limbs.
All12sprites must be centered within their own exact cells and never overlap neighbouring cells. These are painted gameplay assets, not icons and not a scene. Actual alpha transparency.
